_comment: Code Editor, native emtk window. The project tree and the symbol list are declared tables (emtk view_form data_table over gui/editor_app.py CodeEditorGui); menus, toolbar, editor and docks are drawn in code.

project.description: The files of the project folder. Click a file to open it; expand a folder with its triangle or a double click. Right-click a row for its actions. Click a header to sort. In a narrow pane Date Modified, Kind and Size give way to Name (a row's tooltip lists them).

context_menu.label: Open in editor
context_menu.description: Open this file in a tab of the editor.

context_menu.label: Use as project root
context_menu.description: Show this folder's files as the project.

context_menu.label: Copy path
context_menu.description: Copy the full path of this file or folder to the clipboard.

context_menu.label: Copy relative path
context_menu.description: Copy the path relative to the project folder to the clipboard.

context_menu.label: Copy file name
context_menu.description: Copy the name of this file or folder to the clipboard.

columns.title: Size
columns.tooltip: File size; empty for a folder.

columns.title: Kind
columns.tooltip: Folder, or the file's type by its extension.

columns.title: Date Modified
columns.tooltip: When the file was last changed.

symbols.description: Classes, functions, methods and sections of the active Python document, read from the unsaved text. Click a row to jump to it.

columns.title: Symbol
columns.tooltip: Name of the class, function, method or section (methods as Class.method).
